title: Yoga studios in London compared by styles, beginner classes and prices
intro: This guide compares nine yoga studios listed on Google Maps for 'yoga studio in London' on 25 November 2026, excluding sponsored listings. Every fact comes from each studio's own website as fetched on that date, or from its Google Maps listing where the website could not be fetched; prices and timetables change, so check the studio before booking. Studios are listed alphabetically and no ratings or rankings are given. Indaba Yoga Studio was left out because its own site announces closure on 30 November 2026.

businesses.name: Energy Yoga
businesses.hours: Google Maps: open, closes 5 pm (25 Nov 2026)
businesses.note: The website energyoga.co.uk could not be fetched on 25 November 2026 (http redirects to https, whose TLS certificate has expired), so only the Google Maps facts are recorded.

businesses.name: Iyengar Yoga London
businesses.address: 223a Randolph Avenue, Maida Vale, London W9 1NL
businesses.hours: Daily classes (site); Google Maps: closes 8 pm (25 Nov 2026)
services: Iyengar yoga (beginners, general and intermediate levels)
60+, gentle, pregnancy, children's and teenagers' classes
remedial yoga and yoga for MS/neurological conditions
businesses.prices: Studio drop-in: 75 min £12.50 visitor / £9.50 member, 90 min £18.50 / £14.25, 120 min £23.25 / £18; online 60 min £11 / £8.50. Annual membership £65 (autopay £60). Six-week beginners course £85 (£25 for under-25s and full-time students). Free one-hour taster classes.
businesses.note: A members-run not-for-profit charity; the site says B.K.S. Iyengar helped found the centre in 1984 and opened the purpose-built studios in 1994 (one large studio that divides into three units).

businesses.name: MoreYoga Soho
businesses.address: Marshall Street Leisure Centre, 15 Marshall Street, Soho, London W1F 7EL
businesses.hours: Soho classes 22-28 Nov 2026: earliest 7:30am, latest finish 8:30pm; Google Maps: closes 10 pm (25 Nov 2026)
businesses.prices: Intro membership: £1 first month then £44/month (new members, 2-month minimum, offer stated to end 30.11.2026); monthly unlimited one month only £88; returning members £54/month; 4-class pass £23, 8-class pass £56, 12-class pass £74; annual pass £365.
businesses.note: Part of a chain of '40+' studios across London; memberships give access to all studios.

businesses.name: Mudra Yoga London
businesses.address: 2 Shelford Place, Stoke Newington, London N16 9HS
businesses.hours: Daily classes (site); Google Maps: closes 9 pm (25 Nov 2026)
services: beginner-friendly classes (Slow Flow, Restore, Yin, Pause & Breathe)
businesses.prices: Drop-in £17; unlimited 14-day intro £50; 5-class pack £75, 10-class pack £140, 20-class pack £200; memberships £55/month (1 class a week), £80/month (2 a week), £110/month (3 a week); workshops average £35.
businesses.note: The site describes the studio as 'part of the local fabric since 2013', next to Clissold Park.

businesses.name: Stillpoint Yoga London
businesses.address: Room AR1, West Wing, Guy's Campus, St Thomas Street, London Bridge, London SE1 9TL
businesses.hours: Mysore classes Mon-Fri, 'start anytime after 6:30 and finish by 9:00' (site); Google Maps: opens 6:30 am
services: online live-stream classes six days a week
businesses.prices: New students: 2 weeks for £50. Memberships (include unlimited online classes): 2 classes a week £95/month, 3 a week £125/month, 5 a week £140/month. Beginners course £80. Online-only membership £60/month, online trial £20 for two weeks.
businesses.note: Founded by Scott Johnson; the site says it has been 'sharing Ashtanga yoga since 2009'. Morning-only in-person schedule.

businesses.name: The Shala School of Yoga
businesses.address: 3rd floor, 1 Chestnut Road (537 Norwood Road), West Norwood, London SE27 9EZ
businesses.hours: Vahni classes from 7:15am to 7:15pm start (site 'next up' list); Google Maps: closes 6 pm (25 Nov 2026)
services: CPD modules (yin, somatic, menopause, yoga nidra, trauma-informed)
public classes at the same address run by Vahni: vinyasa, slow flow, yin, restorative, qi gong, somatic movement, pregnancy yoga
businesses.prices: Teacher training: 200-hour £3,250; 300-hour from £3,900; Yoga Philosophy Club £30 drop-in. Public classes (Vahni, same studio): single class £20; introductory pass £39 for 21 days unlimited; 6-class pack £96, 10-class pack £140; monthly unlimited £110; 20% concessions on single classes and packs.
businesses.note: The Shala School of Yoga site says classes and workshops in West Norwood are now run by Vahni, its sister organisation at the same address; the School itself focuses on teacher training and cites '29 years in South London'.

businesses.name: Yogarise Peckham
businesses.address: 1st Floor, The Bussey Building, 133 Copeland Road, Peckham, London SE15
businesses.hours: Google Maps: closes 9 pm (25 Nov 2026); full timetable is in the booking app
services: reformer pilates ('for total beginners and regulars alike')
yoga nidra and sound bath workshops
online classes and on-demand library in the Yogarise app
businesses.prices: Studio drop-in £18 (yoga and mat pilates); reformer drop-in £25; studio intro offer £45 for 21 days unlimited yoga/mat pilates; reformer intro offer £45 for 4 classes in 21 days; 5-class pack £75, 10-class pack £140, 20-class pack £260; monthly pre-pay unlimited studio + online £105; off-peak monthly £79; Platinum (unlimited reformer + yoga + online) £250/month.
businesses.note: One of three Yogarise studios (Peckham, Streatham, Queen's Park); the site does not print the Peckham street address, which is taken from Google Maps.

sources: Google Maps listings for 'yoga studio in London', 25 November 2026 (addresses and opening/closing times; sole source for Energy Yoga)
